limitations: One sample per profile; ten seconds of offered load within a real 60-second poll.
No HTTP/TLS/CDN or independently failed disk, host, zone or region.
No CPU/IO/wait-event profile; cannot attribute saturation to one component.
Private synthetic key ledgers are not included in published aggregate reports.
